<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarService" name="Car Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CarService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FineOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Owner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceCompleted" name="Previous service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToNecessary</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToNecessary</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Necessary_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">serviceNecessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is still registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Necessary_ToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToAttend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AttendService" name="Go to the service?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToAttend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attend_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attend_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without going to the service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attend_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine the car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attend_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Problems_ToUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email while the owner waits">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Problems_ToUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_ToRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair the car">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_ToRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_ToPay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_ToPay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter that the repair was successful and the owner got the Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Success_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for the next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Success_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToNecessary" sourceRef="Start_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Necessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegistered" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToAttend" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attend_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">goes to service</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attend_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">does not go to service</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Problems_ToUpdates" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_ToRepair" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_ToPay" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Success_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToAttend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AttendService" name="Does the owner go to the service?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToAttend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attend_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attend_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without going to the service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attend_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine the car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attend_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Problems_ToWorkSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairWorkSplit" name="Repair and status updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Problems_ToWorkSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair the car">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email while the owner waits">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Is the repair done?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairWorkJoin" name="Repair and waiting complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ToPay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app when the repair is done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ToPay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter that the repair was successful and the owner got the Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Success_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for the next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Success_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForRepair" name="Wait for the repair, which can take several days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_ToUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToNecessary" sourceRef="Start_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Necessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegistered" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notRegistered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToAttend" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attend_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">goesToService</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attend_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">doesNotGoToService</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Problems_ToWorkSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToRepair" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToWait" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitForRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToUpdates" sourceRef="Task_WaitForRepair" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorkJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairDone</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notRepairDone</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ToPay" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_ToSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Success_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarService" name="Car Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CarService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FineOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Owner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_OwnerAttends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceSuccessful" name="Previous service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">serviceNecessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is still registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToAttendanceOrTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" name="Wait for service attendance or 30 days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToAttendanceOrTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToAttend</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OwnerAttends" name="Owner goes to the service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToAttend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attend_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">ownerAttendsService</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without service attendance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Timeout_ToFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FineOwner" name="Fine the car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Timeout_ToFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attend_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Problems_ToStatusUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates by email while waiting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Problems_ToStatusUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairNotDone_ToStatusUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Is the repair done?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter that the repair was successful and the owner got the Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for the next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary" sourceRef="Start_ServiceSuccessful" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegistered" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToAttendanceOrTimeout" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToAttend" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_OwnerAttends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendanceOrTimeout_ToTimeout" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attend_ToEnterProblems" sourceRef="Catch_OwnerAttends" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timeout_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FineOwner" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Problems_ToStatusUpdates" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdates_ToRepairDone" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairDone</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not repairDone</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that an activity continues while a milestone or other condition is pending, and that a later phase follows once the condition is met: Model a decision point after the activity: route the unmet outcome back to repeat the activity and the met outcome to the later phase.
rules.situation: the description says an activity continues while a condition is pending and a follow-up action is allowed only once that condition is met

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description specifies an action, decision, or outcome for a process element

rules.instruction: When the description makes a later action depend on a condition being met, but does not describe an activity that performs that condition: Model the condition as a decision gateway with flows for the possible outcomes; do not add an activity that performs the condition in place of the gateway.
rules.situation: the description makes a later action depend on a condition being met, but does not describe an activity that performs that condition

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant incurs a penalty or other consequence: Model the imposition of that consequence as a BPMN activity, rather than representing it only as an end event.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant incurs a penalty or other consequence
